responses.text: {Player in NCR gear} Hey there. Is McCarran having you check up on us?
McCarran doesn't like it when civilians wander into military outposts, so if you're here on business, better make it quick.
You're back. What's up?
All quiet at the moment. Ranger {BOH-mont} Beaumont is in charge here, but he's off leading a patrol.
It was quiet until those rockets blasted off over our heads.
There was a hell of a boom over at REPCONN. Looks like the ghouls had some sort of accident with their rockets.
See you around.
Simple enough to change. I doubt the Legion's listening in on us - they're not that sophisticated - but better safe than sorry, right?

topics.prompt: I've brought new security codes for this station's radio from Sergeant Reyes.

responses.text: Radio signal out here can be pretty spotty because of all the hills. Sometimes our scheduled updates don't go through.
When it happens enough times, they send someone over to check up on us. Lately, we've been getting extra medical supplies for some reason.
I'm in no rush to give the supplies back, either.
Ranger Station Charlie. We're responsible for keeping the highway up through Novac civilized.
{NCR - Devil} Something tells me this isn't the first time you've done things that the NCR would find... objectionable.
Here, take some of these. And don't tell anyone where you got them.
{NCR - not Devil} I shouldn't have said anything in the first place, and I'd rather not get you into the habit of crossing the NCR.

topics.prompt: Mind if I take some of those extra medical supplies?

responses.text: We're part scout, part commando, part sheriff. The training is brutal, and I'd say eight out of ten recruits washes out before the end.
Before you get your Ranger badge, you've got to prove you can be quieter than a shadow and more ferocious than a Deathclaw.
Sure.
Couple dozen, I'd say, most of them posted at stations like this one. We either man the station or patrol the immediate area.

topics.prompt: Are there a lot of Rangers in the Mojave?

responses.text: The Rangers mostly draw from the basic NCR army. A trooper who shows exceptional skill at fighting and scouting can be nominated for the training.

topics.prompt: How does someone become a Ranger?

responses.text: See you around.
